subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should `openclaw tui --agent <id>` become the canonical explicit startup selector, overriding cwd inference and rejecting a conflicting agent-scoped `--session`?
rationale: The capability is demonstrably missing, but the durable behavior of two public selectors and existing inferred/remembered state cannot be chosen safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit selector
options.body: Validate configured agent ids, let `--agent` override cwd inference, and return a clear error when it conflicts with an agent-scoped session key.

options.title: Keep current selection paths
options.body: Continue supporting canonical session keys, workspace inference, the picker, and `/agent` without adding another public option.

recommendation.title: Add explicit selector
recommendation.body: Validate configured agent ids, let `--agent` override cwd inference, and return a clear error when it conflicts with an agent-scoped session key.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the TUI and its current agent-selection surface and has already reviewed this exact behavior gap.
